That set is my sentimental favorite. I originally made the D20 because my girlfriend is a huge LotR fan, and ended up making the whole set because people kept requesting it.
This is pretty awesome! Do all your designs have a consistent roll balance to them? That is to say, are they biased at all?

They have no appreciable roll bias. Obviously, there have to be slight differences between the weights of the number markings, but we're talking about differences of milligrams. On top of that, I usually arrange the sides so that there is no clustering of "heavier" and "lighter" numbers (not that it really matters because the differences are so incredibly small anyway.)

So, they are effectively unbiased.
